question: Can I build up unused FHSA participation room in years before I open my first FHSA?
generated_answer:
No. You can only build up unused FHSA participation room in years after you open your first FHSA. 1.10 How do I build up unused FHSA participation room? You build up unused FHSA participation room by calculating the difference between your FHSA annual contribution limit and the amount you actually contribute to your FHSA in the year. Any unused room is available to you in the following year. Example 1

In 2021, you are 25 years old and you open your first FHSA. Your annual contribution limit is $6,000. You contribute $2,000 to your FHSA in 2021. You have unused FHSA participation room of $4,000.
